match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: DEV rushes in with a laptop, tells MARA about the leaked memo, and MARA answers without leaving her place. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Observational handheld frame with MARA at the monitor in the foreground; leave open space at the edge for DEV to enter. Placement only, not the pose: MARA sits facing the monitor, tired and still, wearing a green cardigan; DEV is not yet in frame. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld drift, then follow DEV into the room, immediate, slightly unsteady. Characters: MARA, Woman, 40s, An adult woman with a medium build, Green cardigan over a simple light blouse, dark. DEV, Unspecified, 20s, A young adult reporter of average height, A charcoal casual jacket over a muted crew-neck. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
